subsystem.name: StreamDecoderRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Runtime objects for stream-based image and command decoding: the state-machine host object that owns the decoder state, the dispatch-target object it reports through, the refillable byte-stream read state, and the JPEG/command segment parsers. Driven externally by ImageTextureDecompressor (0x00501722) and CommandDispatchStateMachine (0x0051126A); a single initializer (0x0050F632) also performs render/camera setup calls.

summary: Fourteen functions form one decoder host object (state at this+0x10, stream at this+0x14, dispatch target at *a1 via this+0x0, runtime function-slot objects at this+0x8/0x17C/0x180/0x18C/0x190) plus three reusable sub-objects: a dispatch target with a state-code/parameter window, a refillable byte stream, and a JPEG frame-header component table. The functions cover object initialization, state-machine dispatch, buffer/stream read processing, and the JPEG/command segment parsers (JFIF APP0, Adobe APP14, Huffman tables, byte-pair commands, slot-table commands, 2-byte tokens, generic JPEG markers). Ownership trust is LOW/UNKNOWN throughout; the class grouping is a DERIVED proposal grounded in shared field bases, shared caller sets, and shared numeric state codes.

function_roles.role: Object initializer: clears status flag this+0x4, performs two conditional vtable dispatches (opcodes 10/19, expected values 61/424) through the dispatch target, memsets the 0x1A8-byte struct while preserving the vtable pointer, sets ready byte this+0xC, calls RenderVTableObjectInit (0x00516883), sub_5115EE (0x005115EE) and DirectorCameraObjectSetup (0x00515ECD), conditionally refreshes global byte_5D79DC via EFLAGSRegisterCheck (0x005159C3) when it equals 2, then sets state this+0x10 to 200 (the init state consumed by the state machine).

JPEG marker handler: dispatches on the marker selector this+0x20 for case 1 (SOI), 3 (SOF0), 4 (SOS) and invalid; validates component descriptors via the frame-header pointer this+0xC4 (single-component layout, or RGB triplet 82/71/66), drives sub-state this+0x24 and mode this+0x28, reports errors (codes 107/110) through the dispatch-target callback obj+0x4, and ends in a common tail that resets/re-initializes decoder counters and quant fields, returning 1.

State-machine dispatch driver over the state variable this+0x10: state 200 (init) calls the function slots this+0x190 and this+0x14+8 then advances to 201; state 201 falls through to the shared processing function at this+0x18C; state 202 is terminal (returns 1); states 203..208/210 route directly through this+0x18C; any other state writes opcode 18 plus the state to the dispatch target (obj+0x14/0x18) and dispatches through obj+0x0, returning 0. On a successful processing call (result 1) it invokes handleJpegMarker (0x0050F6F7) and sets state 202.

State-machine dispatcher for states 205/206/207/210: on 205/206 with flag byte this+0x40 clear it conditionally posts opcode 66 to the dispatch target when the counter this+0x78 is below the limit this+0x60, calls the transition slot *(this+0x17C)+4 and moves to state 210; state 207 also moves to 210; other non-210 states post opcode 18 plus the state and dispatch through obj+0x0. A do-while loop polls the processing object *(this+0x18C); when its completion byte +0x11 is set it invokes the final-dispatch slot *(this+0x14)+0x18 and calls VirtualDispatchConditionalValue (0x00516937), returning 1.

Buffer-processing state machine: when state this+0x10 is not 204 it re-initializes via the init slot *(this+0x17C)+0, resets the counter this+0x78 and sets state 204; while the active flag *(this+0x17C)+0x8 is set it flushes batches at the limit this+0x60 (flush slot *(this+0x17C)+4 then re-init), calls the per-chunk progress callback at this+0x8 with counter/limit in slots +4/+8, and advances through the processing slot *(this+0x180)+4; unchanged counter aborts with 0; completion sets final state 205/206 selected by byte this+0x41.

Stream-buffer read dispatcher: initializes the dispatch target (opcode 18 + source state into obj+0x14/0x18, dispatch through obj+0x0) when state this+0x10 is not 205, primes the secondary callback object this+0x8 with the read position this+0x78 and buffer size this+0x60, advances the read position through the dispatch-object vtable slot 1 (this+0x180 plus 4) until the buffer is exhausted, then signals completion (opcode 119) through the completion handler obj+0x4 with (this, -1) and returns 0.

Multi-state processing state machine: state 202 constructs the object (ObjectConstructor_6f76, 0x00516F76) then either short-circuits to done 207 (early-exit flag this+0x40) or transitions to 203; state 203 runs a dispatch loop through the callback this+0x8 and the processing object *(this+0x18C), incrementing the callback counter *(this+0x8)+4 and extending its limit *(this+0x8)+8 by this+0x118; on result 2 it copies this+0x7C to this+0x84 and hands off to BufferProcessingStateMachine (0x0050FA0E); any other non-203/204 state writes opcode 18 plus the state through the dispatch target (obj+0x14/0x18, obj+0x0) before falling through to BufferProcessingStateMachine.

Command-context reset: sets the dispatch-target state code obj+0x14 to 101 and dispatches (obj, 1); overrides to state 60 with a no-arg dispatch when the re-entry flag *(this+0x190)+0x50 is already set; initializes the three 16-byte field arrays near this+0xDA (values 1, 5, 0), resets context fields this+0x24, this+0xFC, bytes this+0x100/0x101/0x106/0x107/0x108 and words this+0x102/0x104, sets the re-entry guard flag *(this+0x190)+0x50 to 1, and returns 1.

Stream command parser with slot-table lookup: reads a variable-length command (2-byte size header, slot count, per-slot id/parameter pairs, trailer) from the refillable stream this+0x14, validates size against slot count (error state 9), linearly searches the 21-dword slot table at this+0xC4 for each slot id (table-size guard this+0x20, error state 5), stores found entries at this+0x124, publishes per-slot values (states 102/103) and the trailer (state 104) to the dispatch target, resets the completion flag this+0x1E4, increments the command counter this+0x7C and returns 1.

JFIF (APP0) marker parser: reads the big-endian segment length from the refillable stream this+0x14, consumes 14 header bytes, validates the 'JFIF\0' signature (else state 76), checks the major/minor version (states 88/115), stores density units at this+0x101 and X/Y densities at this+0x102/0x104, mirrors them to the dispatch target (obj+0x18..0x20), drives states 86/89/87 for densities and thumbnail data, then persists the stream position and skips any unconsumed bytes before returning 1.

Adobe (APP14) marker parser: reads the two-byte segment length from the refillable stream this+0x14, validates the 'Adobe' signature, decodes four big-endian values (DCT encoder version, two flag words, color transform) into the result object (obj+0x18..0x24), records the Adobe marker present at this+0x106 and color transform at this+0x107, sets state 75 (or 77 on short/mismatched segments), then persists the stream position and consumes leftover bytes before returning 1.

Byte-pair command stream decoder: reads a big-endian length, iterates (length - 2)/2 ID/value pairs from the refillable stream this+0x14, reports each pair through the dispatch target (state 78 with parameterized dispatch obj+0x4, state 26 when ID >= 32, state 27 when the low nibble exceeds the high nibble), stores nibble-split values into the this+0xCA/0xDA arrays (and full bytes at this+0xDA+ID for IDs 16..31), persists the stream position and returns 1.

JPEG Huffman table (DHT) parser: for each table in the segment reads the table-id byte, dispatches state 79 with (this, 1), reads 16 code-length count bytes (dispatched as state 85 batches through obj+0x18..0x34), validates the symbol count against 256 and the segment length (error state 28), reads the symbols, selects a table slot from the this+0x70/0xA0-area slot arrays (error state 29), lazily allocates the slot buffer via BufferAccessNullTerminate (0x00516990), writes the 17-byte header plus 256 symbols, then persists the stream position and returns 1.

2-byte big-endian token parser: reads the size field and requires it to equal exactly 4 (on mismatch sets dispatch state 9 and invokes the obj+0x0 error path); on success sets state 81, stores the parsed value at obj+0x18 and this+0xFC, invokes the vtable entry at obj+0x4 with (this, 1), advances the stream read pointer, decrements the remaining count, and returns 1.

classes.name: JpegStreamDecoder
classes.responsibility: Host state-machine object for stream-based image/command decoding. Holds the decoder state at this+0x10, the refillable byte stream at this+0x14, the dispatch-target pointer at this+0x0, batch counters/limits (this+0x60/0x78/0x7C), the marker/component/JFIF/Adobe context region (this+0x100..0x108), the slot/frame table pointer this+0xC4, trailer and slot records (this+0x120..0x174), and runtime function-slot objects at this+0x8, this+0x17C, this+0x180, this+0x18C and this+0x190. All functions in this packet are assigned to this host as a DERIVED grouping; per-function ownership is UNKNOWN.

classes.name: DecoderDispatchTarget
classes.responsibility: Dispatch target object reached through *a1 (host field this+0x0). Vtable slots 0..3 and a state-code/parameter message window: callers write a state/operation code to obj+0x14 and parameters to obj+0x18..0x34, then invoke slot 0 (no-arg dispatch) or slot 1 (parameterized dispatch with an extra argument). Slots 2 and 3 (obj+0x8/0xC) exist but are not visibly read or written in the packet bodies.

classes.name: RefillableByteStream
classes.responsibility: Byte-stream read state reached through host field this+0x14 (also exposed as embedded host fields this+0x18/+0x20/+0x24). Layout: stream+0x0 buffer read pointer, stream+0x4 bytes remaining, stream+0xC refill callback, stream+0x10 skip/consume callback. Parsers refill through the callback whenever the remaining count hits zero, then persist the advanced read pointer and remaining count back on completion.

classes.name: FrameHeaderComponentTable
classes.responsibility: JPEG frame-header object reached through host field this+0xC4 (used by the JPEG marker handler): three component descriptor fields at +0x0/+0x54/+0xA8 validated for a single-component layout or the RGB triplet 82/71/66.

classes.name: TransitionFunctionTable
classes.responsibility: Runtime transition table reached through host field this+0x17C: init function (+0), flush/transition function (+4) and active flag (+8). Functions are assigned elsewhere at runtime.

classes.name: DataDispatchObject
classes.responsibility: Runtime dispatch object reached through host field this+0x180 with a single visible function slot at +4 (the four-argument data-processing call). Function is assigned elsewhere at runtime.

classes.name: ProcessingFunctionObject
classes.responsibility: Runtime processing object reached through host field this+0x18C: processing function (+0), dispatch flag (+0x10) and completion byte (+0x11).

classes.name: ReentryStateObject
classes.responsibility: Runtime state object reached through host field this+0x190 with a single visible flag at +0x50 (re-entry guard).

classes.name: ProgressCallbackObject
classes.responsibility: Runtime progress callback object reached through host field this+0x8: vtable slot 0 (+0), a counter (+4) and a limit (+8). The counter/limit pair is incremented/extended by the state machines; callback semantics external.

state_machines.name: JpegMarkerSubStateMachine
states: marker selector this+0x20: 1 = SOI, 3 = SOF0, 4 = SOS, any other = invalid
sub-state this+0x24: 0 default, 1 SOI, 2 single-component or RGB accepted, 3 SOF0 done, 4 SOS invalid component, 5 SOS valid component
mode this+0x28: 0 invalid, 1 SOI, 2 SOF0, 4 SOS
transitions: marker 1 (SOI) -> sub-state 1, mode 1

marker 3 (SOF0) -> validate component-info (this+0x106/0x107) and frame header *(this+0xC4); component id 0 -> sub-state 2; id not 0/1 -> error 110 via callback; accepted layout -> sub-state 3, mode 2; unknown layout -> error 107
marker 4 (SOS) -> component check (this+0x106/0x107); id 2 -> sub-state 5 else 4; mode 4
invalid marker -> sub-state 0, mode 0
any path -> common tail reset (this+0x40/0x41/0x44/0x4A/0x74/0x58..0x5A = 0, this+0x38 = 1.0) and tail init (this+0x2C/0x30/0x48/0x49/0x50 = 1, this+0x4C = 2, this+0x54 = 256); return 1

state_machines.name: StreamDecoderStateMachine
transitions: 200 -> 201 (0x0050F86A init path calls slots this+0x190 and this+0x14+8)
201 -> 202 (processing via this+0x18C returns 1; handleJpegMarker 0x0050F6F7 invoked; state 202 terminal)
202 -> 203 | 207 (0x0050FB3B constructs object via 0x00516F76; early-exit flag this+0x40 selects 207 else 203)
203 -> 204 (dispatch loop result 2 copies this+0x7C to this+0x84 and hands off to BufferProcessingStateMachine 0x0050FA0E)
204 -> 205 | 206 (buffer drained; byte this+0x41 nonzero selects 205 else 206; 0x0050FA0E)
205 | 206 -> 210 (0x0050F904; with flag this+0x40 clear and counter this+0x78 below limit this+0x60 posts opcode 66, calls transition slot *(this+0x17C)+4; 207 also -> 210)
205 -> read loop (0x0050FAB7 initializes dispatch with opcode 18, reads until buffer this+0x60 exhausted, then completion opcode 119)

state_machines.name: CommandParseDispatchProtocol
states: dispatch state codes written to DecoderDispatchTarget.obj+0x14 before a vtable dispatch
transitions: context reset states 101/60 (0x0050FF84)
slot-table command states 102/103/104 plus guard state 61 and error state 9 (0x0051030D)
byte-pair command states 78/26/27 (0x00510975)
Huffman table states 79/85/28/29 (0x00510ACC)
2-byte token state 81 and size-mismatch state 9 (0x00510F89)
Adobe APP14 states 75/77 (0x005107FB)
error paths dispatch through no-arg vtable slot 0 (obj+0x0); success paths use parameterized slot 1 (obj+0x4)

interfaces.name: DecoderDispatchTarget
interfaces.purpose: Target object pointed at by host field this+0x0 (*a1). Callers write a state/operation code to obj+0x14 and parameters to obj+0x18..0x34, then invoke vtable slot 0 (obj+0x0, no-arg dispatch) or slot 1 (obj+0x4, parameterized dispatch (this, arg)). Slots 2 and 3 (obj+0x8/0xC) exist but are not visibly exercised.

interfaces.name: RefillableByteStream
interfaces.purpose: Byte-stream read state reachable via host field this+0x14. Layout: stream+0x0 buffer read pointer, stream+0x4 bytes remaining, stream+0xC refill callback, stream+0x10 skip/consume callback. Parsers refill through the callback when the remaining count reaches zero and persist the advanced read pointer and remaining count back on completion.

compatibility_contracts.name: DecoderStateVariableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement decoder must keep the current state as an int32 at host+0x10 and preserve the numeric state codes: 200 init, 201 process, 202 done, 203 dispatch loop, 204 buffer processing, 205/206 completion variants selected by byte host+0x41, 207 early exit, 210 post-transition terminal. Entry conditions and transitions are the observable contract of functions 0x0050F86A, 0x0050F904, 0x0050FA0E, 0x0050FAB7 and 0x0050FB3B.

compatibility_contracts.name: DispatchTargetStateCodeProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must preserve the dispatch-target convention: state/operation code at obj+0x14, parameters at obj+0x18..0x34, vtable slot 0 (obj+0x0) for no-arg dispatch and slot 1 (obj+0x4) for parameterized dispatch. Error codes observed: 5, 9, 26, 27, 28, 29, 77, 107, 110; success/progress codes: 10, 18, 19, 60, 61, 66, 75, 76, 78, 79, 81, 85, 86, 87, 88, 89, 101, 102, 103, 104, 115, 119.

compatibility_contracts.name: RefillableStreamContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement parsers must read from a stream state with the buffer read pointer at stream+0x0, the bytes-remaining count at stream+0x4, the refill callback at stream+0xC and the skip/consume callback at stream+0x10, and must persist the advanced read pointer and remaining count back on completion (big-endian multi-byte reads).

compatibility_contracts.name: JpegMarkerDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The decoder recognizes JPEG markers 1 (SOI), 3 (SOF0) and 4 (SOS) on the marker selector this+0x20, validates component descriptor layouts via the frame-header pointer this+0xC4 (single component or RGB triplet 82/71/66), drives sub-state this+0x24 / mode this+0x28, and reports component errors with codes 107 and 110 through the dispatch-target callback.

compatibility_contracts.name: JfifAdobeMarkerContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement JPEG segment parsers must handle JFIF APP0 segments (density flag at this+0x100, density units at this+0x101, X/Y density words at this+0x102/0x104; states 76/86/87/88/89/115) and Adobe APP14 segments (DCT encoder version, two flag words and color transform published at obj+0x18..0x24; Adobe presence at this+0x106 and color transform at this+0x107; states 75/77).

unresolved: The object types behind a1/this and the obj dispatch target are UNKNOWN in every packet function; the JpegStreamDecoder grouping and the sub-object classes are DERIVED proposals, not proven identities.
field:this:0x00000020 reads as a refill callback in the embedded-stream model (0x005105BF, 0x005107FB) but as a slot-table size guard in 0x0051030D; the two readings conflict and are unresolved.
field:this:0x000000C4 reads as a JPEG frame-header pointer in 0x0050F6F7 and as a 21-dword slot-table base in 0x0051030D; unresolved whether one object is reused.
field:this:0x00000024 reads as the stream skip/consume callback (stream+0x10) in 0x005107FB but is reset to 0 as a context DWORD by 0x0050FF84.

0x0050F632 performs render/camera setup (RenderVTableObjectInit 0x00516883, sub_5115EE 0x005115EE, DirectorCameraObjectSetup 0x00515ECD) and an EFLAGSRegisterCheck refresh of global byte_5D79DC; those calls are not explained by the stream-decoder role and may indicate a distinct render/bitmap object constructed during image decompression.
Meaning of the vtable configuration protocol in 0x0050F632 (a2 != 61, a3 != 424, opcodes 10/19) is undocumented.
The dispatch state codes (normal 10/18/19/60/61/66/75/76/78/79/81/85/86/87/88/89/101/102/103/104/115/119; errors 5/9/26/27/28/29/77/107/110) are DERIVED from control flow, not from any naming source.
The composite state chart (200->201->202, 202->203/207, 203->204, 204->205/206, 205/206/207->210) is DERIVED by joining per-function transitions; a single coherent chart is not directly evidenced.

The concrete functions behind the runtime slots at this+0x8, this+0x17C (+0/+4/+8), this+0x180 (+4), this+0x18C (+0/+0x10/+0x11) and this+0x190 (+0x50) are assigned elsewhere at runtime and are not evidenced here.
The slot-table layout at this+0xC4 (21-dword stride, first-dword id key) and the meaning of entry dwords beyond 5/6 are empirical from the 0x0051030D body.
The Huffman slot-table offsets derived from &this[28+...]/&this[40+...] in 0x00510ACC have no packet field references.

obj+0x8 and obj+0xC (dispatch vtable slots 2/3), and this+0x1C, this+0x18, this+0xD8, this+0xDC, this+0x184 and the stream offset stream+0x18 are referenced statically but do not appear in the visible decompiled bodies; their roles are unknown.
Semantics of the 0x0050F6F7 component-info bytes (this+0x100/0x106/0x107) and the marker meanings (1=SOI, 3=SOF0, 4=SOS) are DERIVED, not independently confirmed.
The four-argument data-processing call (this, 0, &this+0x78, 0) and the thumbnail width/height byte mapping in 0x005105BF are DERIVED from usage.
obj+0x0 (the error-code/result field of the callback object) is part of the vtable-call object but is not itself referenced in the visible source.
